title: Coverage Status of a Drug under the Formulary Benefit
content:
## Coverage terms

1. A drug's coverage status for a member is the drug's code in the drug list of the Northbridge formulary that the member's assignment holds on the date of service. A numeric code is the cost-share tier charged under the plan's cost-share rules. NF is non-formulary. EX is a plan exclusion.
2. On a closed formulary, a drug coded NF is not covered unless an exception approval is in force on the date of service. On an open formulary, a drug coded NF or not listed is covered without an exception, at the tier at which an approved non-formulary exception covers a non-specialty drug.
3. While the formulary does not allow excluded drugs to be covered through an exception, a drug coded EX is never covered, whether by exception or by transition fill.
4. Where the formulary excludes brands with an OTC equivalent, a brand with an OTC equivalent is excluded. Compounded prescriptions follow the formulary's compounded-drug standard. A newly launched drug is treated as NF for the formulary's new-to-market review period.
5. A drug whose allowed cost per 30-day supply exceeds the formulary's specialty cost threshold is placed on a specialty tier.
6. Where the formulary prefers biosimilars, its drug list prefers the interchangeable biosimilar over the reference biologic, as the codes show.
7. While the formulary keeps quantity limits on excepted drugs, a drug approved under an exception keeps the quantity limits of the member's Utilization Management Program.

Each Northbridge formulary carries its own structure (closed or open) and its own count of cost-share tiers.

## Status matrix

| Code on the member's formulary | Closed formulary | Open formulary |
|---|---|---|
| 1 to 5 | covered at that tier | covered at that tier |
| NF, no exception approval in force on the date of service | not covered | covered at the non-formulary exception brand tier |
| NF, exception approval in force on the date of service | covered under the approval | covered |
| EX | never covered, by exception or by transition fill | never covered, by exception or by transition fill |

## Worked readings (hypothetical dates)

- Suppose a member's assignment moves from the Northbridge Value Formulary to the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary effective 1 July. A Lantus claim dated 30 June is read against the Value list (tier 3). A claim dated 1 July is read against the Exclusive list (NF).
- On the Northbridge Broad Formulary, a drug that is not on the list at all is covered without an exception.
